title: CellTransformer maps previously uncatalogued regions of the mouse brain
summary: A transformer model applied to spatial transcriptomics mapped fine-grained mouse-brain tissue domains and revealed hundreds of regions absent from existing anatomical atlases. The study evaluated the data-driven domains against the Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework and reported strong alignment alongside the novel subdivisions.
organization: University of California, San Francisco; and Allen Institute

evidence.tested: The study evaluated the data-driven domains against the Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework and reported strong alignment alongside the novel subdivisions.
evidence.unknown: The new domains are data-driven subdivisions; their biological meaning and generalization beyond the analyzed mouse-brain dataset require further study. Nature's paper page was accessible in search and as a PDF abstract, but its HTML reader view redirected to a cookie wall.
evidence.ai_role: The transformer analyzed cell-neighborhood patterns in spatial transcriptomics and assigned tissue domains without manual annotation; human researchers compared outputs with the Allen reference atlas.
